skill.name: bereach-setup
skill.description: Sets up Claude for outreach with BeReach: checks the connector and the skills, and audits old memory and instructions that conflict. Use at setup or when output drifts.
skill.summary: Check BeReach setup, review conflicting outreach rules, and organize approved changes across skills and account memory.
skill.author: bereach-ai

security_audit.summary: The 24 static findings are false positives involving Markdown, documented tool names, normal installation directories, and service URLs. A separate supply-chain risk exists because agents are directed to follow mutable remote setup instructions without an explicit review checkpoint. No evidence found of malicious local prompt injection or credential exfiltration in the two reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Remote setup instructions can change independently of the reviewed skill.
remediation.suggestion: Pin setup instructions to a reviewed revision, treat fetched content as untrusted, and require approval before installation commands or connector changes.

semantic_findings.title: Unreviewed Remote Setup Delegation
semantic_findings.description: The skill says to fetch the remote setup document and follow it, including adding connectors in coding agents. No pinned revision or explicit approval checkpoint protects against changed setup instructions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The local text explicitly delegates setup actions to mutable remote content. This establishes a supply-chain risk, not evidence that the current remote content is malicious.

content.user_title: Set Up BeReach and Review Outreach Memory
content.value_statement: Conflicting outreach instructions and missing setup components can make assistant output inconsistent. This skill checks BeReach readiness and organizes user-approved memory cleanup.
actual_capabilities: Check BeReach connector availability and provide plan or setup guidance when needed.
Identify missing companion outreach skills and explain supported installation paths.
Inventory saved voice, offering, profile, and targeting information through BeReach memory tools.
Classify observed outreach rules as keep, move, or delete and request user validation.
Organize approved memory updates and deletions while preserving replacement playbooks.
Present setup status and instruction cleanup progress using two defined artifact layouts.
limitations: BeReach tools require a working connector and any service plan requested by the status response.
Detailed outreach judgments and voice updates depend on companion skills that are not included here.
Hidden memory and project instructions require user input; some deletions must be completed manually.
Remote setup instructions are mutable, and the reviewed files do not verify their contents.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Outreach Workspace
use_cases.description: Check the connector, required skills, and saved business information before configuring an outreach workflow.

use_cases.title: Resolve Conflicting Writing Preferences
use_cases.description: Compare observed outreach rules with companion skills and propose approved changes to language-specific voice preferences.
use_cases.target_user: Independent consultants maintaining a consistent outreach voice

use_cases.title: Review an Existing Outreach Configuration
use_cases.description: Inventory accessible instructions, identify missing context, and track approved cleanup across memory and project settings.
use_cases.target_user: Revenue operations specialists maintaining outreach workspaces

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my BeReach connector and available outreach skills. Show missing components without changing settings.

prompt_templates.title: Inventory Saved Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my accessible BeReach memory titles and outreach instructions. Mark unavailable sources as unseen and ask me for missing context.

prompt_templates.title: Propose Rule Cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these outreach rules against the installed companion skills. Propose keep, move, or delete for each observed rule, without applying changes.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Approved Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply only my approved BeReach memory changes. Preserve replacement playbooks, merge complete entries, and list manual deletions separately. Verify cleanup where accessible.

output_examples.input: Check setup when the connector is unavailable.
output: Skills: mark each required skill as available or missing.
Saved preferences: not checked while the connector is unavailable.

output_examples.input: Review a saved French greeting preference.
output: Observed rule: Use vous for French first contact.
Proposed action: move to French voice preferences.
Status: waiting for your approval; nothing changed.

output_examples.input: Check cleanup when project instructions cannot be read.
output: Pending: provide the relevant outreach instructions for review.

best_practices: Review fetched setup instructions before approving installation or connector changes.
Approve each cleanup proposal and preserve complete entries before replacement or deletion.
Keep language-specific voice preferences separate and verify cleanup through a fresh read.
anti_patterns: Treating remote setup instructions as trusted without reviewing their requested changes.
Deleting memories or project rules before reviewing and approving the proposed cleanup.
Marking unseen instructions as audited or duplicating the same rule across several memory locations.

faq.question: Does this skill send outreach messages?
faq.answer: Its documented role is setup and memory cleanup. Message drafting and outreach workflows depend on companion skills.

faq.question: Do I need a BeReach connector?
faq.answer: Yes, for status checks and BeReach memory operations. The skill provides setup guidance when tools are unavailable.

faq.question: Can it inspect every saved instruction?
faq.answer: No. It reviews accessible context and asks you to provide memory or project instructions it cannot see.

faq.question: Will it delete memory without approval?
faq.answer: The documented workflow requires your approval before cleanup. Some memory and settings deletions remain manual.

faq.question: Which companion skills does it check?
faq.answer: It checks linkedin-outreach-method, linkedin-personas, linkedin-voice, and linkedin-messages. It includes cold-email only on request.

faq.question: Is the remote setup document covered by this audit?
faq.answer: No. Only the two local Markdown files were reviewed. Inspect remote instructions before allowing installation commands or connector changes.
